sources.title: National park
sources.origin: ONS statistical administrative boundaries; some MHCLG-created data
sources.guard: National park authority boundary is not exact legal designation, parcel suitability or planning approval.

sources.title: Area of outstanding natural beauty
sources.origin: Natural England; all data from authoritative sources
sources.guard: Designation geometry does not determine an exact application outcome.

sources.title: Site of special scientific interest
sources.origin: Natural England attribution; some MHCLG-created data
sources.guard: SSSI presence is a constraint signal, not automatic refusal or parcel score.

sources.title: National nature reserve
sources.origin: Natural England designation; some MHCLG-created data
sources.guard: Reserve boundary is not a development decision or current site condition survey.

sources.title: Local nature reserve
sources.origin: Statutory designation dataset; some MHCLG-created data
sources.guard: Dataset count and geometry do not prove national completeness or exact legal effect.

sources.title: Special protection area
sources.guard: SPA designation requires project-specific assessment; it is not automatic refusal.

sources.title: Special area of conservation
sources.origin: DEFRA/Natural England attribution; some MHCLG-created data
sources.guard: Older source date is retained; geometry is not a current ecological survey.

sources.title: Ramsar site
sources.origin: Natural England/UNESCO context; some MHCLG-created data
sources.guard: International designation is not parcel-level impact, mitigation or permission evidence.
